_meta.title: SEO content generation
_meta.headline: The generator, templates and QA gates are shipped. Zero product articles were written, because zero verified product facts exist for the submitted identifiers.
_meta.rationale: An article about `B04G1MEwY` could only be written by inventing what the product is. Amazon's own rule forbids that: "You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product". The correct output of the content stage under an empty evidence set is an empty content set plus a flag — not fluent prose.

templates.caption: Prompt + layout templates (ready to run once data exists)

columns.label: Mandatory compliance blocks injected by the renderer

rows.name: product-article
rows.sections: H1 (item title, verbatim from API) · short verdict · verified specifications table · what it is good at · limitations · who should not buy it · price & availability line with timestamp · FAQ · disclosure
rows.gates: Associate disclosure · Amazon content disclaimer · price timestamp + price disclaimer · affiliate link with static tag

rows.name: comparison
rows.sections: H1 · verdict summary · comparison matrix (mandatory lowest_new + lowest_used columns) · per-column analysis · trade-off recap · disclosure
rows.gates: As above; additionally fails render if any column lacks both price fields, or if a non-Amazon retailer price appears

rows.name: buying-guide
rows.sections: H1 · how to choose (criteria first, products second) · picks with rationale · category explainer · links to individual reviews · disclosure
rows.gates: Original-content requirement satisfied by criteria-led structure; product-list pages get editorial preamble

rows.name: deal-mention
rows.gates: Renderer deletes the block when `expires_at` < build date and logs the removal

rows.allowed_evidence: Named Creators API field, echoed verbatim
rows.rejected: Model background knowledge about 'this kind of product'

rows.allowed_evidence: API OffersV2 value + retrieval timestamp + disclaimer
rows.rejected: Any remembered or scraped price; any price in a comparison without lowest new and lowest used

rows.allowed_evidence: API aggregate rating or count, with an 'as of' stamp and link to the live listing
rows.rejected: Quoted or paraphrased review bodies; any star rating not API-sourced

rows.allowed_evidence: Amazon-served link containing the promotion, with expiry
This site's own stated methodology and its scores
rows.rejected: Implying Amazon endorsement; '#1', 'best on Amazon', 'Amazon recommends'

rows.allowed_evidence: Framed as the site's own assessment, derived from the grounded rows above
rows.rejected: Presenting AI-generated praise as an independent customer review
